series.title: 备份恢复交接：恢复点校验与超时演练
series.premise: 使用隔离合成订单数据进行夜间时间点恢复。模拟02:15 UTC故障，目标恢复到02:10 UTC提交状态，基础备份来自00:00；03:00开始演练，首批检查到03:42完成。交班时完整对账和应用测试尚未结束。
series.outcome: 接班方核实备份来源、WAL完整性和目标点前后标记，明确五分钟设计恢复点差距。首批可检访问耗时42分钟，未达到30分钟目标，最终验收尚未完成。剩余对账、重试测试与时长复盘明确交接，失败不得接生产或自动提升。

accentTarget.basis: spoken audio duration excluding silence and narration

phraseDefinitions.zh: 备份文件及校验信息清单
用于日志恢复的基础备份
恢复流程已经耗用的时间
恢复异常的升级联系流程

dialogues.title: 交的是演练，不是生产切换
dialogues.premise: 夜班交接恢复演练，先明确数据、环境和验收状态。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听清接班责任不代表批准生产使用。

lines.en: I'll hand over the restore drill. The backup manifest is in our ticket.
lines.zh: 我交接恢复演练，备份清单在工单里。

lines.en: Is this connected to production anywhere? I need the environment boundary first.
lines.zh: 它有任何地方连着生产吗？先明确环境边界。

lines.en: No, a separate test network throughout. Just to confirm, no live cutover, right?
lines.zh: 没有，全程单独测试网络。确认一下，不做线上切换，对吧？

lines.en: Correct, synthetic orders and test credentials. Outbound payment calls are blocked too.
lines.zh: 对，合成订单和测试凭据，对外支付调用也阻断了。

lines.en: Good. Is data validation finished yet? Starting the database isn't full acceptance.
lines.zh: 好，数据验证完成了吗？数据库启动不等于完整验收。

lines.en: Only the initial checks have passed. Full reconciliation still needs your shift.
lines.zh: 只有首批检查通过，完整对账还需要你们班完成。

lines.en: Then show the escalation path clearly. I'll take ownership after reviewing evidence.
lines.zh: 那写清升级联系路径，评审证据后我再接责。

lines.en: Okay, what's the ETA for review? About ten minutes for this handoff.
lines.zh: 好，评审预计多久？这次交接大约十分钟。

lines.en: That works if the evidence opens. Have I missed anything about access?
lines.zh: 证据能打开就可以，访问权限方面我漏了什么吗？

lines.en: So, access is through approved accounts. No production secrets copied into notes.
lines.zh: 那访问使用批准账户，记录里没有复制生产密钥。

dialogues.title: 核实基础备份和来源链
dialogues.premise: 隔离边界明确，接班方核对基础备份标识与文件校验。
dialogues.listeningTask: 辨别备份创建时间、完成时间和恢复目标。

lines.en: The base backup started at midnight. It completed at twenty past, UTC.
lines.zh: 基础备份午夜开始，UTC零点二十分完成。

lines.en: Which backup identifier did you restore? Filenames alone aren't enough provenance evidence.
lines.zh: 恢复的是哪个备份标识？只看文件名不足以证明来源。

lines.en: Drill backup B seventeen, recorded here. Its backup manifest matches verified file checksums.
lines.zh: 演练备份B17，记录在这里，备份清单和已核验文件校验和一致。

lines.en: Just to confirm, drill source only, right? Not a convenient untracked production copy.
lines.zh: 确认一下，只用演练数据源，对吧？不是随手拿的未追踪生产副本。

lines.en: Yes, the dataset approval is attached. Were encryption and restore access tested?
lines.zh: 是，数据集批准记录已附，加密和恢复权限测试了吗？

lines.en: They were, through the approved key service. We recorded outcomes, not secret values.
lines.zh: 测了，通过批准的密钥服务，记录结果而非密钥值。

lines.en: Let me tail the log next. I want the backup identity during startup.
lines.zh: 接下来我盯日志，看启动时确认的备份标识。

lines.en: Okay, I'm on it for that link. Maybe the storage view needs refreshing.
lines.zh: 好，我提供链接，存储视图可能需要刷新。

lines.en: The startup record matches B seventeen. That removes one source mismatch concern.
lines.zh: 启动记录匹配B17，排除了一个来源不匹配疑点。

lines.en: So, our working hypothesis has verified provenance. Next separate backup time from target.
lines.zh: 那当前假设有已验证来源，下一步区分备份时间和恢复目标。

dialogues.title: 五分钟差距是设计边界
dialogues.premise: B17基础备份来源确认，核对模拟故障和恢复目标时间。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听懂恢复点、数据损失窗口和提交边界。

lines.en: The recovery target is two ten UTC. Simulated failure happens five minutes later.
lines.zh: 恢复目标是UTC两点十分，模拟故障发生在五分钟后。

lines.en: So transactions after that point aren't expected? Even if their logs are available?
lines.zh: 所以不期望包含目标点后的事务，即使日志可用？

lines.en: Correct, this drill tests a chosen point. We expect commits through two ten.
lines.zh: 对，这次测试选定时间点，期望包含截至两点十分的提交。

lines.en: Just to confirm, all timestamps UTC, right? We can rule that out as ambiguity.
lines.zh: 确认一下，全是UTC，对吧？可以排除时区歧义。

lines.en: And the target setting is inclusive? Transactions commit, not start, at that boundary.
lines.zh: 目标设置包含边界吗？看的是事务提交时间，不是开始时间。

lines.en: Yes, inclusive and the timeline checked. The base backup precedes that target safely.
lines.zh: 是，包含边界且时间线已检查，基础备份早于目标。

lines.en: Just to recap, five minutes intentionally excluded. That's recovery-point scope, not restore duration.
lines.zh: 小结一下，有意排除五分钟，这是恢复点范围，不是恢复耗时。

lines.en: Exactly, about five minutes of simulated changes. We mustn't call that zero loss.
lines.zh: 对，大约五分钟模拟变更，不能称零损失。

lines.en: Have I missed anything about target selection? Was that loss window approved beforehand?
lines.zh: 恢复点选择方面还有遗漏吗？这个损失窗口提前批准了吗？

lines.en: Okay, yes, the drill sponsor approved it. Final success still requires data checks.
lines.zh: 好，是，演练负责人批准了，但最终成功仍要数据校验。

dialogues.title: 回放停止在目标点
dialogues.premise: 恢复目标和时区明确，核对日志连续性与回放停止记录。
dialogues.listeningTask: 辨别日志归档可用、回放完成和允许接入应用。

lines.en: Archived WAL covers the whole required chain. Segments remain available through two fifteen.
lines.zh: 归档WAL覆盖所需完整链，日志段可用到两点十五分。

lines.en: Did replay stop at the requested point? Availability beyond it doesn't change scope.
lines.zh: 回放停在请求目标点了吗？后面的日志可用不改变范围。

lines.en: Yes, logs show the recovery target reached. We inspected that before test access.
lines.zh: 是，日志显示达到恢复目标，开放测试访问前检查过。

lines.en: Just to confirm, isolation remained intact, right? No application production endpoint was changed.
lines.zh: 确认一下，隔离始终保持，对吧？没有改任何应用生产端点。

lines.en: Let me tail the log myself. I see no missing segment warnings.
lines.zh: 我自己盯日志，没有看到缺日志段警告。

lines.en: The backup manifest checks passed before replay. Timeline and target settings are attached.
lines.zh: 回放前备份清单校验通过，时间线和目标设置已附。

lines.en: Was recovery left paused or ended? I need the current server state.
lines.zh: 恢复还暂停着还是已结束？需要明确服务器当前状态。

lines.en: It ended under the reviewed drill procedure. Test access opened after boundary checks.
lines.zh: 按评审过的演练流程结束，边界检查后开放测试访问。

lines.en: So a smoke test can run. That still doesn't prove every row.
lines.zh: 那可以跑冒烟测试，但仍不能证明每一行正确。

lines.en: Okay, maybe summarize those checks next. Keep completed steps distinct from acceptance.
lines.zh: 好，接下来总结检查吧，把已完成步骤和验收分开。

dialogues.title: 对账要按同一个时间点
dialogues.premise: 回放达到目标点并开放隔离测试访问，核验目标点前后数据。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出行数匹配还不足够，以及为何不能直接比当前生产。

lines.en: Initial reconciliation checks passed for sampled tenants. Counts and payment totals match references.
lines.zh: 抽样租户初步对账通过，行数和付款总额匹配参考值。

lines.en: Which reference time does that represent? Current source totals would be wrong.
lines.zh: 参考值代表哪个时间？当前数据源总额不能直接比较。

lines.en: The frozen drill ledger at two ten. It matches our recovery target exactly.
lines.zh: 两点十分的冻结演练账本，准确匹配恢复目标。

lines.en: Just to confirm, boundary markers too, right? Counts can match with wrong rows.
lines.zh: 确认一下，也查边界标记，对吧？行错了也可能数量一致。

lines.en: Yes, show commits around that boundary. We need positive and negative evidence.
lines.zh: 对，展示边界前后的提交，需要存在和不存在两类证据。

lines.en: The two-oh-nine-fifty-eight commit is present. The two-ten-oh-two commit is correctly absent.
lines.zh: 两点九分五十八秒提交存在，两点十分零二秒提交正确地不存在。

lines.en: Good, the smoke test checks references too. But full tenant reconciliation remains unfinished.
lines.zh: 好，冒烟测试也核对关联关系，但完整租户对账仍没完成。

lines.en: I'm on it for query evidence links. Maybe larger tenants need longer checks.
lines.zh: 我提供查询证据链接，大租户检查可能更久。

lines.en: Full validation? We can rule that out. A sample doesn't cover every tenant.
lines.zh: 完整验收？这可以排除。抽样并不覆盖每个租户。

lines.en: Okay, label the sample coverage clearly. The next shift owns remaining checks.
lines.zh: 好，清楚标记抽样覆盖，下个班负责剩余检查。

dialogues.title: 四十二分钟不是三十分钟达标
dialogues.premise: 首批数据校验通过，核算恢复步骤耗时及尚未完成的最终验收。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分恢复点差距与恢复耗时目标。

lines.en: Restore elapsed time reached forty-two minutes. We started at three, UTC today.
lines.zh: 恢复已耗时四十二分钟，今天UTC三点开始。

lines.en: That's through the initial checked access? Final application acceptance isn't done yet.
lines.zh: 这是到首批经过检查的访问为止？最终应用验收还没完成。

lines.en: Yes, thirty-three minutes restoring and replaying. Nine more minutes for initial checks.
lines.zh: 对，恢复和回放三十三分钟，初步检查又九分钟。

lines.en: Just to confirm, target was thirty, right? The recovery window already exceeded that.
lines.zh: 确认一下，目标是三十分钟，对吧？恢复时间已经超了。

lines.en: Correct. Don't stop the clock retroactively. Remaining reconciliation checks add more elapsed time.
lines.zh: 对，别倒推提前停表，剩余对账检查还会增加耗时。

lines.en: The recovery target still excludes five minutes. That's separate from these forty-two minutes.
lines.zh: 恢复目标仍排除五分钟数据，这与四十二分钟耗时是两回事。

lines.en: Where did the extra time accumulate? Measure download, replay, and validation separately.
lines.zh: 多出来的时间在哪？分别测下载、回放和验证。

lines.en: Download took longer than our rehearsal. Maybe bandwidth limits explain part of it.
lines.zh: 下载比预演久，带宽限制可能解释一部分。

lines.en: What's the ETA for final checks? Call it provisional until jobs finish.
lines.zh: 最终检查预计何时完成？任务结束前只能说暂估。

lines.en: Okay, roughly another twenty minutes estimated. No completed recovery-time claim before acceptance.
lines.zh: 好，估计再二十分钟左右，验收前不宣称恢复耗时已最终确定。

dialogues.title: 剩余校验逐项交责
dialogues.premise: 耗时目标已超出，完整对账和应用行为测试还需接班完成。
dialogues.listeningTask: 抓住未完成事项、负责人和停止条件。

lines.en: Pending validation covers three large tenants. Application retry behavior also needs testing.
lines.zh: 待验证项包括三个大租户，还要测应用重试行为。

lines.en: I'll own the remaining reconciliation checks. Where are expected totals and job IDs?
lines.zh: 我负责剩余对账，预期总额和任务ID在哪里？

lines.en: In the handoff ticket, beside coverage. I'm on it for read access confirmation.
lines.zh: 交接工单里，在覆盖记录旁边，我确认读取权限。

lines.en: Who's picking this up for retries? Lukas, the test harness is yours, right?
lines.zh: 谁接重试测试？Lukas，测试工具由你负责，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, using synthetic writes on a clone. I'll preserve the restored reference database.
lines.zh: 是，在克隆上用合成写入测试，保留恢复参考库不变。

lines.en: Good, retries can change test data. About ten cases cover the known branches.
lines.zh: 好，重试会改变测试数据，大约十个用例覆盖已知分支。

lines.en: I'll keep an eye on failed totals. A mismatch means halt, not patch rows.
lines.zh: 我关注总额失败，不匹配就暂停，不是直接修补行。

lines.en: Okay, another action item is timing analysis. I'll separate transfer from replay tomorrow.
lines.zh: 好，另一个行动项是耗时分析，明天我拆分传输和回放。

lines.en: Maybe we need automated validation preparation. But don't weaken checks for faster numbers.
lines.zh: 可能需要自动准备校验，但别为数字更快而削弱检查。

lines.en: So, update each item with evidence. Completion needs results, not a started job.
lines.zh: 那每项都带证据更新，完成需要结果，不是任务已经启动。

dialogues.title: 接班方复查隔离边界
dialogues.premise: 剩余任务已分配，接班方追问恢复环境和写测试克隆的访问边界。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听清测试克隆不改变恢复参考点。

lines.en: Show me the isolated restore environment. Can its test clone contact production services?
lines.zh: 给我看隔离恢复环境，测试克隆能联系生产服务吗？

lines.en: No, network policy blocks those routes. Both environments use drill credentials exclusively.
lines.zh: 不能，网络策略阻断那些路由，两种环境都只用演练凭据。

lines.en: The reference stays read-only for comparisons. The clone handles synthetic retry writes.
lines.zh: 参考库保持只读用于比较，克隆处理合成重试写入。

lines.en: Just to confirm, reference remains unchanged, right? New test writes aren't restored history.
lines.zh: 确认一下，参考库不变，对吧？新的测试写入不是恢复历史。

lines.en: Let me play that back carefully. Compare reference data, test behavior on clone.
lines.zh: 我仔细复述：参考库对数据，克隆测行为。

lines.en: Yes, label both connection profiles clearly. Maybe the similar names need stronger warnings.
lines.zh: 是，两个连接配置都清楚标记，相似名字可能需要更明显提示。

lines.en: Have I missed anything about cleanup? When will temporary drill credentials expire?
lines.zh: 清理方面还有遗漏吗？临时演练凭据什么时候过期？

lines.en: At noon, unless approved extension happens. Evidence remains in the restricted drill archive.
lines.zh: 中午过期，除非批准延期，证据保留在受限演练归档。

lines.en: Pending validation may need more time. Request extension before expiry, never bypass access.
lines.zh: 待验证可能更久，过期前申请延期，不能绕过访问控制。

lines.en: Okay, the recovery target stays documented. No clone results replace reference-point checks.
lines.zh: 好，恢复目标保持记录，克隆结果不能替代参考点检查。

dialogues.title: 不匹配就暂停并保留证据
dialogues.premise: 接班方确认隔离和权限边界，明确失败时联系谁及不得做什么。
dialogues.listeningTask: 抓住数据不匹配、日志缺口和时间超标的不同处理。

lines.en: Recovery escalation starts with me tonight. Page the backup if I'm unreachable.
lines.zh: 今晚恢复异常先找我，联系不上就呼叫后备。

lines.en: What should halt the validation work? Data mismatch, missing logs, or unsafe access?
lines.zh: 什么情况暂停验证？数据不匹配、缺日志还是不安全访问？

lines.en: Any of those means stop and preserve evidence. No manual row corrections to pass.
lines.zh: 任何一种都停止并保留证据，不能手工改行让检查通过。

lines.en: Just to confirm, no production promotion, right? A failed drill stays isolated throughout.
lines.zh: 确认一下，不提升成生产，对吧？失败演练全程保持隔离。

lines.en: And archived WAL gaps need source review. Don't invent a newer target instead.
lines.zh: 归档日志缺口需要复查来源，不能擅自换成更新恢复点。

lines.en: The escalation path includes backup storage owner. I'll attach their approved contact entry.
lines.zh: 升级路径也包括备份存储负责人，我附上批准联系人记录。

lines.en: What's the ETA if reconciliation stalls? We need a reporting deadline as well.
lines.zh: 对账卡住时预计何时更新？还需要报告期限。

lines.en: Update at four ten even if unfinished. Maybe sooner for any data mismatch.
lines.zh: 即使未完成也四点十分更新，数据不匹配则更早。

lines.en: The time target is already missed. That needs review, not unsafe shortcuts.
lines.zh: 耗时目标已未达标，需要评审，不是走不安全捷径。

lines.en: So, preserve logs and exact job outputs. We'll investigate before restarting the drill.
lines.zh: 那保留日志和准确任务输出，重做演练前先调查。

dialogues.title: 接收责任，不提前签验收
dialogues.premise: 来源、恢复点、校验覆盖及升级条件明确，接班方复述并接责。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分交接接收和恢复演练最终验收。

lines.en: Handoff acceptance means I own next steps. It doesn't mean the drill passed.
lines.zh: 接收交接代表我负责下一步，不代表演练通过。

lines.en: Just to recap, source and point verified. Pending validation still blocks final acceptance.
lines.zh: 小结一下，来源和恢复点已核验，待验证仍阻止最终验收。

lines.en: Correct, sampled reconciliation checks passed already. Three large tenants remain with Hannah.
lines.zh: 对，抽样对账已通过，三个大租户由Hannah继续。

lines.en: And Lukas owns clone retry testing, right? The unchanged reference keeps its target.
lines.zh: Lukas负责克隆重试测试，对吧？不变的参考库保持目标点。

lines.en: I've got it from here for reconciliation. I'll report failures without editing results.
lines.zh: 对账我接下了，失败会如实报告，不修改结果。

lines.en: Okay, I'm available through four thirty. About twenty minutes remains our estimate.
lines.zh: 好，我四点半前都可联系，估计仍需二十分钟左右。

lines.en: I'll report at four ten either way. Final elapsed time stays open until acceptance.
lines.zh: 无论结果我四点十分更新，最终耗时到验收才确定。

lines.en: So, no claim of thirty-minute recovery. We'll review the timing gap tomorrow.
lines.zh: 那不宣称三十分钟恢复达标，明天评审时间差距。

lines.en: Evidence links and access work now. I accept the remaining validation responsibility.
lines.zh: 证据链接和权限现在都可用，我接收剩余验证责任。

lines.en: We'll close the loop after your results. Keep the drill separate from production.
lines.zh: 你们结果出来后闭环，演练继续与生产分开。
